title: Time Off Policy
content: Submit your leave request through HR and await manager approval.

title: Remote Work Policy
content: Remote work requests should be discussed with your manager and approved in advance.

title: Equipment Policy
content: Equipment requests are handled by IT and require manager approval.

title: Task Help
content: If you're stuck on a task: check the task details on your Dashboard checklist first, upload any document it asks for, and if you're still blocked, message your manager directly. Tell me the task name and I can point you to the right policy if that's what's holding you up.

title: Raise a Concern
content: This is a private space — nothing you share here is visible to your manager. Go ahead and describe what's on your mind. For anything I can't resolve, I'll connect you with a real HR contact so it gets proper attention.

title: Policy Question
content: I can help with the Time Off, Remote Work, and Equipment policies right now — just ask about one of those by name, or tell me what situation you're in and I'll point you to the relevant policy.

title: Document Help
content: You can upload documents straight from a task on your Dashboard checklist — open the task and use the upload option. If you're not sure which document a task needs, tell me the task name and I'll clarify what's required.
